notes: This is a parody of '12 Days of Christmas' featuring Pete the Cat. Key vocabulary centres on the song structure (counting, days, gifts), Pete's signature 'groovy' and 'cool' expressions, and Christmas-themed items. 'Groovy' may not have a direct Boardmaker symbol — consider a thumbs-up or happy face as a substitute, or source a custom icon. 'Twelve' maps to the numeral 12 in the library. The repetitive song structure makes 'day' and counting words very useful for following along page by page.
